tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das ngan song yongs su sbyong ba kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi chog bsgrigs don gsal ngag gi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi chog bsgrigs don gsal ngag gi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rnam par snang mdzad dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig ma rig mthug pos rab bsgribs shing*// mun chen 'jigs pa'i nang du gnas pa la// kun nas rta bdun rgyal po'i tsha zer gyis// gsal mdzad rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal// yo ga rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud rgyal don// sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa rab sbyong zhing*// thar lam ston byed rnam snang kun rig gi// chog bsgrigs gsal zhing rgyas pa 'di 'chad do// de'ang 'di'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang thob pa'i gang zag gis rang gzhan gyi don bya ba'i phyir du yo byad rnams 'du byas la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing mche ba 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya byas te/ rang nyid rdo rje gnod sbyin gsal gdab/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gzi byin bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur par dmigs te/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum brjod/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ e h+ye hi ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ/ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ lan gsum/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe| dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad/ zhes sbyar bas mchod/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ gang gi sa phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i// phyogs skyong lha klu gnod sbyin sogs// 'byung po bgegs dang gdon gyi rigs// sa la rgyu zhing dbang sgyur ba'i// sha za srin po la sogs rnams| |'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhi zhing dul ba'i sems ldan pas// bdag gis bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu 'di// kun nas mchis par ma gyur bar// sa phyogs gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// da ni gnas 'dir rnam snang gi// dkyil 'khor chen po bsgom par bgyid// gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na// ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba yis// bgegs rnams brlag par gdon mi za// de bas rang rang gnas su dengs// oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥ bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas mchod pa rnams bsangs/ gzi byin bskyed/ sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba so so'i nang du a yig zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar sbyar bas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ rkang gnyis mchog gyur 'das dang ma 'ongs dang*// da ltar bzhugs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas rnams dang*// zhi ba chags bral theg gsum dam pa'i chos// sde snod bka' dang man ngag lung gi tshogs// 'phags mchog skyabs kyi mchog gyur dge 'dun te// rigs kun gtso bo rnam snang la sogs la// bdag cag skyabs su mchi zhing sems can rnams| |ngan song gsum las myur du bsgral bar bya// de phyir brtson pas byang chub sems bskyed do// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed brjod/

lce dang lag pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ las rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ mdun gyi 'dab ma lcer gyur pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa de nyid lce la thim pas/ lce rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba re re'i dbus su hūm̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje'i lag pa sor mo rnams kyang rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam par gyur par bsams/ slar yang hūm̐ las rang nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sngon po phyag gnyis rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtug /slar yang phyag rgya pad+ma 'dra ba spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes dang*/ phyag rgya rdo rje 'dra ba dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ phyag rgya rin po che 'dra ba rna ltag g.yas su bzhag la/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ phyag rgya pad+ma 'dra ba ltag par bzhag la/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ phyag rgya de bsgyur ba rna ltag g.yon du bzhag la/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes brjod/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdud pa bcangs pa'i tshul snying ga /mgrin pa/ ltag pa nu ma'i bar/ dpral ba/ spyi bo/ lte ba rnams su gtug cing*/

oṃ ṭuṃ/ zhes brjod cing sngags re re nas gnas re rer gtugs la slar yang thal mo brdab cing*/ oṃ badz+ra tuṣ+ya hoḥ dar dkar po zheng du khru gang ba/ srid du khru nyi shu pas gnas rnams su mdud cing*/ rna ltag tu byung ba lhag ma phyes te brgyangs pas rang gi lus tshad dang mnyam par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas khro bo spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms// dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can// log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba// rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal// log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod la/ hūm̐ */ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// 'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing*// thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa// khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can// gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras// ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhag pa'i ye shes rol par ston byed cing*// sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams// nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa// sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// dpa' ba'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/

rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ */ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod la/ hūm̐ */ dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bsgom// khyed rnams da lta gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// gal te mi 'gro bka' las 'das gyur na// khro rgyal khros pa'i bka' chad drag po yis// khyod kyi lus sems nyams shing brlag par byed// de bas bgegs tshogs gnas su myur du dengs// oṃ suṃ bha ni brjod cing bka' bsgos la/ gnas bsrung ba ni// g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing g.yon khu tshur snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐/ bgegs la bsnun par bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings la steng du mnan pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag la/ sor mo rnams 'bar ba lta bu la/ mthe bong gnyis rtse sbyar ba srin lag dang gung mo'i bar du bzung ba rdo rje me'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bgegs rnams bsregs par bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i steng nas mthe bong gnyis brkyangs nas rdo rje can gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra bhan+dha sarba bigh+nāṃ/ zhes pas bgegs lhag ma rnams bcing bar bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa brkyangs te kha sbub pa sa la bzhag ste/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa bhan+dha rak+ṣa sarbāṃ swā hā/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi chen por gyur par bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bskor te mgo bo'i steng du mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar bzhag pa rdo rje 'jigs byed can gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng rdo rje'i gur khang du gyur par bsam/

rdo rje thal mo'i mthe bong gnyis brkyangs la/ mche ba 'dzin pa'i tshul rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐| gur khang gi nang du rdo rje'i bla brer gyur par bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ mdzub mo rtse sprad de bzlog nas spyi bor bzhag pa rdo rje gtsug tor phyag rgyas khu tshur mkhrig ma mdun nas zhags dmigs ltar byas pa rdo rje zhags pa'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ druṃ bhan+dha haṃ/ shar rdo rje'i ra bar gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hrīḥ shar gyi ra ba'i nang du'ang rdo rje'i ra bar gyur par bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa mthe bong gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung byas te mdzub mo gshibs te phye la mthe'u chung gnyis ba dan ltar byas pa/ rdo rje ba dan gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra pa taṅke pa taṅke ni ra ṭa/ nub rdo rje'i ra bar gyur par bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur kha steng du bstan pa gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya de nyid kha'i thad du zhugs pa rdo rje dus kyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kā li ru ṭa ma ṭa/ byang rdo rje'i ra bar gyur par bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur steng du bstan pa ri bo 'degs pa'i tshul du byas pa rdo rje rtse mo'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra shi ṣa ra ru ṭa ma ṭa/ lho rdo rje'i ra bar gyur par bsam/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo dang gung mo gnyis rdo rje ltar byas pa rdo rje las kyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra karma/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra bar gyur par bsam| rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad mthe'u chung sbrel mdzub mo sdigs mdzub byas pa rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ nang rdo rje'i ra bar gyur par bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra bhan+dha baṃ/ slar yang ra ba'i steng du rdo rje gur gyi rnam pa can du gyur par bsam/ de nas rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung mdud pa snying gar bzhag pas g.yas skor du bskor ba rdo rje 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas/

oṃ sarba bid maṇ+ḍal badz+ra tsakra hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par mos la/ phyag rgya de nyid snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pā da ban+da naṃ ka ro mi/ zhes phyag bya/ de nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ yan lag bdun pa ni/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas sras bcas dang*// byang sems nyan rang tshogs la bdag phyag 'tshal// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod// bdag gi sdig pa bgyis dang bgyid bstsal dang*// de la yi rang gyur pa gang mchis pa// 'phags mchog khyed kyi spyan sngar mthol zhing 'chags// rgyal ba'i sras kyi tshogs gnyis zab pa dang*// 'gro don mdzad pa de las gzhan la yang*// rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// khyod kyis 'jig med 'khor lo bskor ba la// rtag tu mi bsnyel chos kyang bstan du gsol// ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong bar// dam pa khyod kyi skyabs mgon las gzhan ci// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs su gsol// bdag gis dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge// gdod nas yod pa'i dge ba 'dis mtshon te// 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces lan gsum gyis lan lag bdun pa dang*/ de nas sdom pa gzung ba ni/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bgyi bas// dus ni 'di nas bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// byang chub nges mdzad byang chub sems// rtag tu bdag gis bskyed par bgyi| |tshul khrims rnam gsum bdag gis bsrung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spong*// rdo rje rigs mchog las byung ba'i// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya 'dzin// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog dam tshig ste// sbyin pa rnam bzhi dus drug tu// nyin re bzhin du mkhas pas sbyin// pad+ma'i rigs can dag pa yi// phyi nang gsang ba theg gsum gyi// dam tshig so sor gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi| |mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// sems can don phyir sdom pa gzung*// ma bsgral bsgral dang ma grol dgrol// dbugs ma phyin rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ tshogs zhing rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsgom/ rang gi lag mthil gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i dbus su hūm̐ āḥde dag gi mthar a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ste dbyangs yig bcu drug gis g.yas su bskor ba'i g.yas g.yon gyi sor mo rnams su/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥlas rnam snang dkar po/ mi bskyod pa sngon po/ rin 'byung ser po/ 'od dpag med dmar po/ don yod grub pa ljang gu ste yab lnga dang*/ g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo/ rdo rje thugs ma sngon mo/ rdo rje dbang bskur ma ser mo/ rdo rje mtshon cha ma dmar mo/ rdo rje kun ma ljang gu ste yum lngar gyur pa'i yab yum rnams dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rang rtags kyi phyag mtshan dang bcas pa phan tshun lha dang lha mo rnams zhal phyogs par gyur par bsams la/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tā sarba dharma pa ram+ba ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharma badz+ra añja li/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje bsdams pa lan gsum sgra dang bcas pa snying khar byas la/ a d+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭa sarba dharma bhan+dha badz+ra bhan+dha traṭa/ ces brjod/ rdo rje 'bebs pa'i dam rgyas bcings la/ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya a aḥ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa hṛ da yaṃ me/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer byung ba bdag la thim par bsams la/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi dam rgya bcings la/

badz+ra muṣ+ṭi/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ/ zhes phyag rgya de nyid dgrol bar bya'o// de dag ni phyag rgya spyi'i cho ga'o// de nas bdag gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gzi byin bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ze'u 'brur a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ gyi mthar/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags phreng dkar po g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po lta bu zhal bzhi dkar ba phyogs bzhir gzigs pa/ phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs gsol ba/ zhi ba'i gzigs stangs can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de yang ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog bzhin pa nyi ma 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba/ de ltar gsal ba'i thugs kar ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ dkar pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs par mos la/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar byas lag ngar gnyis bsnol te gung mo dang mthe bong gnyis kyis se gol brdab cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya byas la/

badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol| |zhes dang*/ gdan dbul bar mos la/ pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ zhes sgo ba bzhi'i dam rgyas dgug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī āḥlas rigs lngas brgyan par gyur par dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i las rgyas bsrungs la/ tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ngan song gi rgyud las rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chen pos ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba dang*| bsdu ba mang po'i phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas phyu+ung*/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas so// kun tu snang bar byas nas sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las rnam par grol te/ bde ba so sor thob nas rang gi gnas thams cad kun tu snang bar byas te/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyis mngon par mchod nas brgya phrag stong du bskor ba byas te mgo bos lan brgya phrag stong du phyag btsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de 'di skad ces gsol to// e ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag sbyangs nas// byang chub spyod pa nyid la bkod// ces ched du brjod nas mi snang bar gyur to// mchod pa ni sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs/

bsod nams zhing du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas la// snang la rang bzhin med pa'i mchod yon 'di// snang stong dbyer med sems kyis 'bul lags na// bde stong gnyis med thugs kyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ gong gi mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad zhes sbyar la mchod/ bstod pa ni/ dril stabs dang bcas pas/ 'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ */sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas/ */thugs rjes dug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa// thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can smin cing grol bar bya ba'i phyir// sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang*| |chags pas ma gos pad+ma ltar dag pa// 'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud// sems can bkren pa chos kyi phongs gyur pa// ma rig 'thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams| |'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa// ye shes sgron me khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa la// thugs rje thabs dang shes rab grur bzhag nas// zhi ba rin chen gling du skyel mdzad pa// kun gyi ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can las kyi chu bor nub pa la// dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*| |'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa// gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ gi mthar snying po dang*/ de'i mthar rtsa rig gi sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros// sems can thams cad kyi don byas tshur 'dus sngags phreng la thim zhing 'khod par gyur pa la dmigs te/ oṃ oṃ bde legs su gyur cig

/sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kun rig gis sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong la bsnun/ zhes bzla'o// slar yang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha na rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad sbyong ba'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ tad+ya thā/ 'di lta ste/ oṃ sho dha ni shodha ni sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni sdig pa thams cad sbyongs sbyongs rnam par sbyongs/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ dag pa rnam par dag pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i ched du gzhi tshugs/ zhes ci rigs bzla'o// de dag ni bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/// / ༈ /de nas bum pa gnyis gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab/ bcud kyis sum gnyis bkang ba mgul chings kha rgyan dang ldan pa gtso bum gyi steng du rnam rgyal chen po'i dung chos dris bkang ba bzhag /de'i steng du gzung thag rdo rjes spras pa bzhag la/ bum pa gnyis bsangs/ gzi byin bskyed/ sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bāṃ bāṃ las byung ba'i bum pa gnyis dkar po lto ba che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa ring ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul bcings shing dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ bcud bzang pos yongs su gang ba'i bum pa gnyis kyi rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du dbus su bum mtshan a seng a las zhes pa nas/ rgyab yol dang ldan pa zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar dang*/ las bum gyi nang du pad zla'i gdan la bum mtshan k+ṣaṃ las mche ba k+ṣaṃ gis mtshan pa las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po lto ba yangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas rab tu mtshan pa'i mche ba zhal gyi grwa gnyis su 'dzin pa stag lpags kyi smad g.yogs pa zhabs sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa zla ba 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba|

gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs par mos la/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ skabs 'dir dril stabs dang bcas pas mdun bskyed ltar spyan 'dren rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bya'o// de nas dam rgya ni/ phyag rgya mdun bskyed kyi skabs ltar byas la/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ sarba bid dṛsh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ sarba bid/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces rang rang gi snying po gsum gsum brjod/ de nas rigs lnga rnams la'ang sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pa nas a haṃ bar gong ltar las/ snying po'i gnas su/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ ces dang*/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ zhes sogs/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur la bya'o// de nas phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca āḥ de ltar dbang bskur bas rigs lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa re res dbu brgyan par gyur par bsam mo// 'dir rigs lnga dang rdo rje gnod sbyin la phrin las mdun bskyed ltar bcol/ de nas sngar ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos kyang mchod la| gling bzhi srid gsum 'jig rten na// bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i// mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa rnams// mos blos bdag gis yongs bzung ste// bum pa'i lha tshogs mchod phyir 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la mchog dgyes mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/

zhes dang*/ de bzhin du chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams so sor sbyar la dbul lo// de nas dril stabs dang bcas pa'i bstod pa ni/ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings// chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku// byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad// phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la// gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa// me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku// bdud 'dul chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad// phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la// rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me// mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid// mchog sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad// phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la// 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi chu// kun rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid// ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad// phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la// phrag dog rdo rje skyod pa'i rlung*// bya grub ye shes rdo rje'i sku// skyabs sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya mdzad// phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la// zhes bstod/ so sor kun rtog phrin las bdag /rdo rje gnod sbyin sku mdog nag /phyag gnyis rdo rje mche ba 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la// zhes bstod la/ lha rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las lha'i tshogs 'phros 'gro ba'i don byas slar 'dus rang rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim par gyur par dmigs te/ snying po dang rtsa rig brgya rtsa brgyad sogs bzlas shing*/ las bum la dmigs pas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs bzla'o// de nas rtsa rig brgya rtsa sogs bzlas la/ slar yang chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod la/ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das// rigs bzhi sems dpa' bzhi dang bcas// rdo rje gnod sbyin drag po cher// bdag gis dad pas bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/ dung chos kyi chu rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha la mchod yon phul/

bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag dang slob ma rnams la dbang gi rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs rnams zlog par mdzod cig /ces brjod/ de dag ni bum pa sta gon gyi rim pa'o/// / ༈ /de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs/ gzi byin bskyed/ sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu rdo rjes mtshan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ raṃ hūm̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa rdo rje rtse dgu pas mtshan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bum pas mtshan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa ser po rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ suṃ hūm̐ las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin gru bzhi pa rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa de'i steng du/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje de'i lte bar bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas sngo/ ser/ dmar/ ljang*/ dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga'i steng du ba ku li ser po rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ de'i steng du gser gyi ska rags bzhi la btags pa'i mu tig gi do shal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du ba ku li sngon po la ril ba dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa lta bus spras pa'i steng du pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mda' yab dang bcas pa'i phyi rol tu 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod rdzas 'dzin pas mchod pa/ sgo bzhir ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i steng du chos 'khor gyi g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mos brgyan pa/

nang ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung bzhi mig mang ris su bris pa'i dbus byur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i nang du de'i phyed kyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs med pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs te/ de ltar gzhal yas khang phyi nang gnyis ldan gyi phyi rol du sna tshogs pad+ma dang rdo rje'i ra ba/ de'i phyi rol tu ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi steng dang 'og gi sa gzhi thams cad shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus dkar ba'i gzhal yas khang nang ma'i dbus su 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i dbus su a sing a las seng ge/ shar du hūm̐ ghaṃ hūm̐ las glang chen/ lhor trāṃ a trāṃ las rta mchog /nub tu haṃ maṃ haṃ las rma bya/ byang du a gaṃ a las mkha' lding gis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba lha'i gnas thams cad du hrīḥlas pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du mdzad/ slar 'dus chos kyi yi ge la thim yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad ces pa nas/ nyi ma 'od kyi rgyab yol mnga' ba zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar dang*/ phyogs bzhir hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ trāṃ las rin po che trāṃ gis mtshan pa/ hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa/ āḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje āḥs mtshan pa rnams las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ 'gre'o/ yongs su gyur pa las shar du sbyong ba'i rgyal po sku mdog dkar po phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte 'og tu 'dzin pa/

lhor rgyal mchog rin chen mthing kha g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas rin po che cha dgu pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu shākya ri dbang dmar ser phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du me tog cher rgyas sna tshogs mdog g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyas sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa nyi ma 'od kyi rgyab yol dang ldan pa/ mtshams bzhir zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ las 'khor lo hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ trāṃ las rdo rje trāṃ gis mtshan pa/ hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa/ āḥlas ut+pal āḥs mtshan pa rnams las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ yongs su gyur pa las shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo g.yas spyan gyis spras pa'i 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma kī sngon mo g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas ut+pal 'dzin pa/ bzhi ka'ang g.yon gdan la brten te bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu drug pa pad zla'i gdan dang bcas pa/ shar gyi rtsibs bzhi la hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ dzaḥlas lcags kyu dzaḥs mtshan pa/ hoḥlas mda' gzhu hoḥs mtshan pa/ dhu las rdo rje dhus mtshan pa/ de rnams las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ yongs su gyur pa las rtsibs dang po la rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po g.yas pa'i sor mo gsum bsgrengs pa'i rtse mor rdo rje 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ gnyis pa la rdo rje rgyal po ser po phyag gnyis kyis lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ gsum pa la rdo rje chags pa dmar po rdo rje dang ut+pal las mtshan pa'i mda' gzhu rna ba'i bar 'gengs pa/ bzhi pa la rdo rje legs pa ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis bzung nas legs so sbyin pa/

lho'i rtsibs bzhi la trāṃ las rin po che trāṃ gis mtshan pa/ r+ya las nyi ma r+yas mtshan pa/ bh+ri las rgyal mtshan bh+ris mtshan pa/ hā las so'i phreng ba hās mtshan pa/ de rnams las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ yongs su gyur pa las rtsibs dang po la/ rdo rje rin chen ser po g.yas rin po che dpral bar 'jog cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ gnyis pa la rdo rje gzi brjid dmar ser g.yas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rdo rjes mtshan pa 'dzin cing g.yon gdan la brten pa/ gsum pa la rdo rje rgyal mtshan sngon po g.yas nor bu'i tog gis spras pa'i rgyal mtshan phrag pa g.yon du sgreng zhing g.yon gdan la brten pa/ bzhi pa la rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po g.yas so'i phreng ba kha 'gram g.yas su 'dzin cing g.yon gdan la brten pa/ nub kyi rtsibs bzhi la hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa/ dhīḥlas ral gri dhīḥs mtshan pa/ kruṃ las 'khor lo kruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ bhā las lce bhās mtshan pa/ de rnams las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ yongs su gyur pa las rtsibs dang po la rdo rje chos dmar po phyag g.yon pad+ma'i gong bu dkur brten pa g.yas pas kha 'byed pa/ gnyis pa la rdo rje rnon po mthing ga g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul dang g.yon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/ gsum pa la rdo rje rgyu ser po g.yas pa'i gung mo'i rtser 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa bskor ba'i tshul dang g.yon gdan la brten pa/ bzhi pa la rdo rje smra ba dmar po g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lce 'dzin cing g.yon gdan la brten pa/ byang gi rtsibs bzhi la kaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje kaṃ gis mtshan pa/ raṃ las go cha raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ k+ṣaṃ las mche ba k+ṣaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ ṭaṃ las rdo rje ṭaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de rnams las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ yongs su gyur pa las rtsibs dang po la rdo rje las sna tshogs mdog g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/

gnyis pa la rdo rje srung ba ser po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje'i go cha 'dzin pa/ gsum pa la rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i mche ba zhal gyi grwa gnyis su 'dzin pa/ bzhi pa la rdo rje khu tshur ser po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis 'tshir ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyi grwa bzhir pad zla'i gdan la/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ trāṃ las phreng ba trāṃ gis mtshan pa/ hrīḥlas pi wang hrīḥs mtshan pa/ āḥ las rdo rje āḥs mtshan pa/ de rnams las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ yongs su gyur pa las shar lhor sgeg mo dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa gnyis 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu phreng ba ma ser mo rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ nub byang du glu ma dkar dmar phyag gnyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i pi wang gi sgras bskul ba/ byang shar du gar ma sna tshogs mdog phyag gnyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa gnyis bsnams nas gar byed pa/ de rnams kyi rgyab kyi grwa bzhir pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ las spos snod hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ trāṃ las me tog trāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ hrīḥlas mar me hrīḥs mtshan pa/ āḥlas dri'i dung phor āḥs mtshan pa/ de rnams las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ yongs su gyur pa las shar lhor bdug spos ma dkar mo phyag gnyis spos snod 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu me tog ma ser mo phyag gnyis g.yon me tog gi snod 'dzin cing g.yas pas char 'bebs pa/ nub byang du mar me ma dmar skya phyag gnyis mar me'i kong bu 'degs pa/ byang shar du byug pa ma sna tshogs mdog g.yon dri'i dung phor 'dzin cing g.yas pas 'byug par mdzad pa/ nang gi sgo bzhir pad zla'i gdan la dzaḥlas rdo rje lcags kyu dzaḥs mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las rdo rje zhags pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ baṃ las rdo rje lcags sgrog baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ hoḥlas rdo rje dril bu hoḥs mtshan pa/

de rnams las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ yongs su gyur pa las shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu dkar po phyag gnyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor rdo rje zhags pa ser po phyag gnyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor rdo rje lcags sgrog dmar po phyag gnyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor rdo rje dril bu sna tshogs mdog g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin cing g.yon gdan la brten pa/ spyan ma nas 'bebs pa'i bar thams cad kyang rin po ches brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ zla ba 'od kyis rgyab yol dang ldan par gyur/ rta babs dang ldan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi lha snam nang ma'i pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje rnams kalpa bha dra'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa bcu drug las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ yongs su gyur pa las shar du byams pa/ mthong ba don yod/ ngan song kun 'dren/ mya ngan dang mun 'joms bzhi dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lhor spos kyi glang po/ dpa' bar 'gro ba/ nam mkha' mdzod/ ye shes tog bzhi ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med/ zla 'od/ bzang skyong*/ dra ba can gyi 'od bzhi dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ byang du rdo rje snying po/ blo gros mi zad pa/ spobs pa brtsegs pa/ kun tu bzang po bzhi sna tshogs mdog sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha snam bar ma'i pad zla'i gdan la 'khar gsil bcu drug shra ba ka'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ yongs su gyur pa las shar du dga' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ shā ri'i bu/ maud+gal gyi bu/

lhor rab 'byor| 'char ka /ma 'gags pa/ kauṇ+ḍi n+ya/ nub tu nye bar 'khor/ rta thul/ ba lang bdag /kun dga' bo/ byang du ming chen/ nor 'dzin/ gang po/ 'od srung de rnams kyang sku mdog sna tshogs pa/ po ti lhung bzed 'khar gsil 'dzin pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gyon pa/ lha snam phyi ma la pad zla'i gdan la 'khar gsil bcu gnyis pra t+ye ka'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ yongs su gyur pa las shar du gdung ba sel ba/ snang ba brtsegs pa/ lhor dpa' bo 'dul ba/ shes rab mgyogs chen/ nub tu smra ba'i sgra gcan/ bse ru lta bu/ byang du rdzu 'phrul cher ston/ seng ge sgra/ shar lhor 'jigs pa med pa/ lho nub tu ri bo rgyal/ nub byang du dug chen 'joms/ byang shar du yid myur ba rnams sku mdog ma nges pa/ phyag na lhung bzed dang 'khar gsil po ti 'dzin pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gyon cing dbu'i gtsug tor cung zad dang bcas pa/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i sgo bzhir pad zla'i gdan la/ rdo rje la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan bcu drug badz+ra kro dha'i ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros| yongs su gyur pa las shar sgor khro bo 'jig rten gsum snang*/ g.yas su bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ g.yon du dus kyi srin mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi lcags kyu ma/ lho sgor khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'dul/ g.yas su dbyug sngon can/ g.yon du dus kyi dbyug pa ma/ rgyab tu dus kyi zhags pa ma/ nub sgor khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'ching*/ g.yas su mi g.yo ba/ g.yon du dus kyi mtshan mo/ rgyab tu dus kyi lcags sgrog ma/ byang sgor khro bo 'jig rten gsum 'jig /g.yas su rta mgrin/ g.yon du dus kyi gnod sbyin ma/ rgyab tu dus kyi dril bu ma thams cad kyang sku mdog ma nges pa/ dbu dang phyag mtha' yas pa/ g.yas pa thams cad kyis mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin cing*/

g.yon pa rnams kyis mgo thod shas gang ba dang ma rungs pa'i rgyu ma drangs te zhal du gsol ba/ sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris pa g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyi'i 'khor yug dkar po la pad+ma sna tshogs pa'i steng du zla ba'i gdan la phyogs skyong bcu/ gza' chen brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ klu chen brgyad/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ gtsang rigs kyi dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga rnams dang*/ 'jigs byed dgu chung ma dang bcas pa/ dbang phyug chung ma dang bcas pa/ drag po chung ma dang bcas pa/ rdo rje phra men ma rnams dang*/ ri'i lha dang*/ shing gi lha dang*| grong gi lha dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i lha dang*/ lo zla zhag dus kyi bdag po la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i lha thams cad kyang sku mdog sna tshogs pa la rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin cing cha lugs sna tshogs pa dang bcas pa/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par mos la/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar byas la lag ngar gnyis bsnol te gung mo dang mthe bong gnyis kyis se gol gtogs pa/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir| |yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che// dad pas spyan ni drangs par bgyi// zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa// dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs// chos dang ye shes chags bral pa// kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan/

tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha// thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen// shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par bstsal du gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka āt+maka e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ye swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon 'bul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o| |oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan dbul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nyer spyod sogs kyis mchod nas/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ zhes sgo ba bzhi'i dam rgyas dgug gzhug bcings mnyes byas nas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi las rgyas phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ/ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i las rgyas bsrung ba bya/ oṃ pra wa ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul/ phyag 'tshal ba'am mnyam pa'i thal mo dpral bar sbyar la/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ snyim pa'i phyag rgya mgrin par bzhag la/

oṃ sarba bid āḥ rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas brkyang gung mo gnyis dang tha ma gnyis sbyar nas snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ zhes gnas gsum byin gyis brlab bo/ de nas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab pa'i dang po dam rgya ni/ lha thams cad thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su thog mtha' med pa'i chos nyid kyi ngo bo dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur par dmigs te/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes lag pa byin gyis brlabs te/ rdo rje bsdams pa bcings la/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ zhes mig byin gyis brlabs pas/ lag pa gnyis mnyam bzhag mthe bong lte sprad la/ rnam snang gi dam rgya bcings la/ sarba bid dṛ sh+ya/ zhes ye shes la blta/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dgug gzhug /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ rgyab tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bskyed/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ/ rang dang gnyis su med pa'i nga rgyal bya/ sarba bid zhes snying po lan gsum brjod/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gtso bo'i sngags kyang lan gsum brjod/ de bzhin du/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ nas/ snying po lan gsum brjod pa sngar bzhin byas la/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang*/ mdzub mo dang srin lag gnyis pad+ma 'dra bar bcug pas sbyong rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag gnyis rin po che 'dra bar byas pas rgyal mchog rin chen gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ mthe'u chung dang mthe bong gnyis so sor bsnyams la lhag ma rnams brkyang ba shākya ri dbang gi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ lag pa g.yon de bzhin du bsgyur zhing bya ba me tog cher rgyas kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ de bzhin du/ su ra ta s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa/ bud+dha lo tsa ni dṛ sh+ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya staṃ a haṃ bud+dha lo tsa ni zhes snying po lan gsum/ oṃ bud+dha lo tsa ni zhes sngags lan gsum brjod do// de bzhin du mā ma kī nas khro bo bcu drug gi bar la sbyar te/

khyad par ni/ badz+ra mā ma kī| badz+ra pāṇ+ḍa ri/ badz+ra tā re zhes sogs dang rang rang gi snying por dṛ sh+ya gdag /a haṃ gi mjug tu rang rang gi snying po dang sngags lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje sems dpa' nas 'bebs pa'i bar gyi 'byin sngags rnams kyi mgor/ oṃ dang mthar sa bon med pa'i snying po dang*/ yod pa ni de rnams kyi sngags so// mgron thabs ni sngar bshad pa'i kalpa bha dra sogs kyi ming yig ni snying po yin la/ sngags ni bskal bzang rnams kyi rang gi 'byin sngags yin la/ gzhan rnams kyi ni rtsa rig yin no| |lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar la mdzub mo gnyis gdu bur byas te mthe bong rtse mor mig gi tshul du byas pa ni spyan gyi phyag rgya'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis sbreng ba'i tshigs gsum par mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje'i tshul du bzung pa ni mā ma ki'a'o| |thal mo khong stong du sbyar te pad+ma kha phye ba'i tshul du byas pa ni gos dkar mo'o// lag pa thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba la mdzub mo gnyis bkug pas gung mo'i sen mo mnan te mthe bong gnyis dbus su bzhag nas cung zad bkug pa ni sgrol ma'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs te rdo rje 'dra bar byas pas rdor sems kyi phyag rgya dang*/ de nyid las mdzub mo g.yas pa bkug pa rdo rje rgyal po'i dang*/ de nyid las me tog 'dra bar byas pa chags pa'i dang*/ de nyid slar bkug ste mthe bong la mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad pa legs pa'i dang*/ de nyid las tshigs bar ma bcag pa rin chen gyi dang*/ de nyid las sor mo rnams 'od zer 'dra bar bkyed pa gzi brjid kyi dang*/ de nyid spyi bor bzhag pa rgyan mtshan gyi dang*/ de nyid kha'i mdun du bzhag pa bzhad pa'i dang*/ de nyid pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa chos kyi dang*/ de nyid rtse mo yid tsam bkug pa rnon po'i dang*/ de nyid las gdu bu 'dra bar byas pas rgyu'i dang*/

de nyid las pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa smra ba'i dang*/ de nyid las rtse mo yid tsam bskyed pa las kyi dang*| de nyid las shin tu bskyed pa bsrung ba'i dang*/ de nyid las rtse mo gnyis slar bkug pa gnod sbyin gyi dang*/ de nyid las dam du bkug pa khu tshur gyi dang*/ snying gar rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis bsnyams te bshibs nas bzhag pa sgeg mo'i dang*| rdo rje bsdams pa rab tu brkyang pa ste phreng ba 'chang ba'i tshul du byed pa phreng ba ma'i dang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa las byung ba'i rdo rje thal mos tshig 'byin pa'i tshul du kha gyen du 'byung ba ltar byed pa glu ma'i dang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa las byung ba'i gar byas la thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag pa gar ma'i dang*/ bsdams pa nyid thur du 'dug pa'i tshul du bzhag pa bdug pa ma'i rgya dang*/ de nyid gyen du bskyed pa me tog ma'i dang*/ mdun du mthe bong bsnyams te bskor ba mar me ma'i dang*/ de nyid las dri byug ba ltar byas pa dri'i dang*/ de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis bkug pa lcags kyu'i dang*/ de nyid las rtse mo gnyis sprad ba zhags pa'i dang*/ de nyid las gcig la gcig mdud pa lcags sgrog gi dang*/ de nyid las mthe bong gnyis nang du bkug ste skyod pa 'bebs pa'i dang*/ g.yon pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur bkan la g.yas pa'i mtheb mdzub gnyis kyi mthe'u chung nas brtsams te phye la thal mo khong stong du byas pa ni skal bzang rnams kyi dang*/ lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i sor mo kun bkug nas gang ba'i mdzod ltar gnas pa lag gnyis bskyed nas mthe bong mthe'u chung gnyis rtse sprad de sor mo rnams brkyang ba nyan thos kyi dang*/ lag pa thal mo sbyar nas sor mo'i rtse mo rim pa bzhin mtshan ma bsdus nas kha sbyor du byas te mthe bong gnyis bsgrengs nas bskums pa rang rgyal gyi dang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings te gung mo rtse sprad pa brkyang tha ma bzhi so sor bsgreng ba khro bo'i dam rgya'o// gnyis pa chos rgya ni/

lha thams cad kyi lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ mdun gyi 'dab ma gcig lcer gyur pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga chur nyal ba/ rdo rje'i lte bar lha rang rang gi sngags kyis mtshan par gyur par dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa/ zhes lce byin gyis brlabs te lus kyi lha so so'i phyag chen bcing zhing ngag tu lha so so'i sngags brjod do// gsum pa las rgya ni/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'i mtshan par gyur par bsam la/ gar dang glu dang ro dang zas// spyod lam la sogs bde ba rnams// sangs rgyas rnams la phul nas ni// las kyi phyag rgya dbang du gyur// ces brjod cing rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las byung ba'i gar gyi 'cham byas la/ lha so so'i snying po/ sarba bid ces brjod/ g.yon lte bar ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yas snying gar rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul ni rnam snang gi dang*/ g.yas rim pa bzhin sa gnon/ mchog sbyin/ ting nge 'dzin/ mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyi chos gos kyi grwa 'dzin pa'i tshul du snying gar bzhag pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i dang*/ yum bzhi phyag mtshan med pa'i phyag chen ltar bcing ba'o// g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur kha nang du bltas la dkur bzhag g.yas pa'i khu tshur bkan te gyen du bstod pa'i tshul gyis snying gar bzhag pa rdor sems kyi dang*/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur snying kha'i mdun du bzhag /de'ang mdun du g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur bzhag nas lcags kyu 'dzin pa ltar byed pa rgyal po'i dang*/ g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bkan te bzhag pa'i steng du g.yas pa kha sbub tu bzhag ste/ yang g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis mda' 'dren pa'i tshul gyis rna ba la thug gi bar du gzhu 'gengs pa ltar byas nas mda' 'phen pa'i tshul du byed pa ni chags pa'i dang*/

rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gcig tu byas nas snying gar bzhag nas mtheb mdzub gnyis kyis se gol rdeb pa legs so sbyin pa'i tshul ni legs pa'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dbang bskur ba'i gnas mdzod spur bzhag pa rin chen gyi dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur snying gar g.yas skor du zlum por bskor ba gzi brjid kyi dang*/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur la g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis gru mo btsugs pa ni rgyal mtshan gyi dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgod pa'i tshul du sgeg pa dang bcas pa yongs su bskor nas kha'i grwa gnyis su bzhag pa ni bzhad pa'i dang*/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur pad+mar bsams la snying gar bzhag /g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis mtheb mdzub kyi pad+ma kha 'byed pa'i tshul du mthe'u chung nas rim pa bzhin 'byed pa ni chos kyi dang*/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul du byed pa ni rnon po'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar g.yas phyogs nas lus kyi phyi rol tu bskor ba ni rgyu'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha nas tshig 'byung ba'i tshul gyis gyen du bteg pa ni smra ba'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi sor mo rnams rim gyis bkrol ba las byung ba'i thal mo sbyar ba 'gram pa gnyis dang spyi bor bzhag pa ni las kyi dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis sngar go bgo ba ltar byas nas mthar go bskon pa'i tshul du byas pa ni srung ba'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis mthe'u chung brkyangs nas bkug pa mche ba'i rtse mo ltar byas te kha'i grwa gnyis su bzhag pa ni mche ba'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gcig gis gcig btsir ba ni khu tshur gyi dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dku gnyis su bzhag la bsam pa g.yas pa'i mgo g.yon du 'dud pa ni sgeg mo'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis phreng ba 'ching ba'i tshul du byed pa ni phreng ba ma'i dang*/

rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi kha nas tshig 'byung ba'i tshul du gyen du 'dren pa ni glu ma'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis gar bskor ba ni gar ma'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis bdug pa 'thul ba'i tshul du thur du bdug pa ni bdug pa ma'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis me tog 'bul ba'i tshul gyis gyen du 'thor ba ni me tog ma'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba ni mar me ma'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rab tu brkyangs nas rang gi snying gar dris byug pa'i tshul du byed pa ni dri chab ma'i dang*/ g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar byas la g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur mthe'u chung lcags kyu ltar byas pa la bcings pa ni lcags kyu'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mkhrig ma'i rgyab sbyar zhags pa'i dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo lcags kyu 'dra bar byas nas kha nang du thad kar bzhag nas phan tshun mdud cing mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel ba ni lcags sgrog gi dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sbyar te 'tshir ba ni 'bebs pa'i dang*/ skal bzang man chod mgron thabs rnams kyi las rgya ni gar las byung ba'i phyag mtshan med pa'i phyag chen ltar bcing ba'o// bzhi pa phyag chen ni/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du thog ma'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur par dmigs te/ lus kyi lha so so'i phyag chen bcing zhing*/ ngag tu lha rang rang gis snying po brjod do// spyod rgyud las/ ltag 'og go rim ji bzhin du// sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro// zhes gsungs pas/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ zhes sogs rigs lnga'i sngags dang phyag rgyas lha thams cad la dbang bskur ro// dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin to// de nas phrin las bcol ba ni/ lus kyi rdo rje khu tshur las byung ba'i gar sngon du 'gro ba'i ngag tu/

oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha na rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+yathā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes dang*/ rnam snang gi las rgya bcings la/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis bdag sogs sems can thams cad la zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gshin don yin na/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis dmigs yul gyis thog drangs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyi 'jigs pa las 'don pa dang myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /ces dang*/ rtsa rig brjod cing de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i las rgya rim pa bzhin bcing zhing*| oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ sbyong ba'i rgyal po dang*/ oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ rgyal mchog rin chen dang*/ oṃ sarba bid āḥ shākya ri dbang dang*/ oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ me tog cher rgyas te de bzhin gshegs pa bzhis kyang bdag sogs sems can thams cad la zab gsal gnyis su med pa la sogs pa lam gyi rtogs pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin du lus kyi gar sngon du 'gro ba lha so so'i las rgya rim pa bzhin bcing zhing*/ rtsa rig gi mthar lha so so'i sngags brjod cing phrin las bcol bar bya'o// de nas mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs te chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa 'bul ba ni/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// zhes pa'i mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar rnams rim pa ltar sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad kyi mjug tu/

sngar bshad pa'i sngags phyag rgya dang bcas sbyar te/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pa 'bul/ sgeg sogs brgyad kyi mchod pa ni/ lus kyi rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las byung ba'i gar sngon du 'gro bas lha mo rang rang gi las rgya rim pa ltar bcings la/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na// oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra ha da/ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ rdo rje rin chen bla na med// oṃ badz+ra rat+na ma nut+ta raṃ/ badz+ra mā le trāṃ/ rdo rje chos kyis glur blangs pa// oṃ badz+ra dharma gā ya ni/ badz+ra gī ti hrīḥ rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra karma ka rod+bha we/ badz+ra nṛt+ye āḥ zhes nang gi sgeg sogs bzhis lus kyi nyams la pa sogs pas mchod par bsam/ bdug pa ma la sogs pa bzhi'i las rgyas bcings la sngar gyi tshigs bcad sngags dang po'i rjes su badz+ra lā s+ye la sogs kyi gnas su/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke/ badz+ra gan+dhe/ zhes pa rnams rim pa ltar sbyar bas mchod do// mchod pa nyer lnga pa ni/ dpag med bsod nams stobs las byung ba yi// lha rdzas las byung rin chen cod pan mchog /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis rang gi mgor dbang bskur ba'i tshul du byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa pū dza s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes cod pan dang de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po dang*/ tha ma gnyis kun la sbyar te/ snyan shal mdzes byed rin chen 'khyil pa'i rgyan// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis snyan la snyan cha 'dogs pa'i tshul dang*/ mu ku ṭa'i gnas su/ kuṇ+ḍa laṃ zhes rna rgyan dang*/ sngags kyi thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang ci rigs par sbyar ro// mgrin pa dung 'dra mdzes byed mgul gdub mchog /dar+sha zhes pas mgul la mgul rgyan dang*/ thugs mtshan dpal be'u mdzes byed se mo do/

a wa hā ra zhes brang la do shal/ dpung pa mdzes byed dpung rgyan srung skud mchog /ke yū ra zhes dpung pa'i rtsa ba'i 'og tu dpung rgyan/ phyag gnyis mkhrig ma sprad pa'i gdu bu mchog /pa ri ka ṭa kaṃ zhes mkhrig ma'i steng du gdu bu/ dra bas 'brel ba'i sor mo'i gdu bu mchog /pā kaṃ wa la zhes pas sor gdub dang*/ rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i zhabs la mdzes byed rgyan// pā da bha ra ṇaṃ zhes zhabs la zhabs gdub dang*/ sked par ska rags 'bul tshul gyis ska rags te/ rgyan gyi khyad par brgyad do// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// g.yon pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur byas pa'i mthe bong steng du g.yas pa kha thur du bstan pa brkyangs la/ tshā traṃ ka zhes gdugs dang*/ mi mthun bdud las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog /lag pa brkyangs la srin lag gi tshigs dbus ma bkug nas ba dan gsum pa'i tshul bsgrengs nas lag pa gnyis brkyangs nas steng du bteg pa ltar bzhag la/ dh+wa dza zhes rgyal mtshan dang*/ snyan pa phyogs bcur 'don pa'i ba dan 'phan// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis nam mkha' la 'phan 'dogs pa'i tshul dang*/ pā daṃ ka zhes ba dan dang*/ phyogs kun yid 'phrog dar gyi lda ldis spras// g.yon pas rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag /g.yas pa'i mdzub mo dang gung mo brkyangs te nam mkha' la lda ldi 'gel ba'i tshul dang*/ pa ṭa da ma zhes lda ldi dang*/ gdung sel rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can// rdo rje khu tshur gyis rnga yab g.yob pa'i tshul dang*/ tsā ma ra zhes rnga yab dang*/ rin chen rgyan 'od ldan pa'i bla bre bres// g.yon pang par mnyam bzhag byas/ g.yas kha thur du bstan te bla re bskyed pa'i bsam pas nam mkha' la yongs su bskor la/ bi tā naṃ zhes bla re ste yo byad kyi khyad par drug go /mi 'jigs bzhi dang ldan pa seng ge'i khri// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gshibs te seng ge'i gdan 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/

singha ā sa na zhes seng khri dang*/ lha rdzas yid 'ong mdzes pa gzims cha'i mchog /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis gzims cha bskon pa'i tshul dang*/ sha ya nā sa na zhes gzims cha dang*/ nyon mongs grwa zur spangs pa'i pho brang zlum// g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur bzhag ste/ g.yas pa'i gung mdzub kyis pho brang zlum po 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ pa ri maṇ+ḍa la dh+ya na zhes pho brang zlum po dang*/ yon tan rgyas pa'i gru bzhi gzhal med khang*// phyag rgya snga ma de nyid kyis gzhal med khang gru bzhi 'bul ba dang*/ e ma ya tsa tur+tha zhes gzhal med khang gru bzhi dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das gru bzhi gnyis brtsegs khang*// de nyid kyis gru bzhi gnyis brtsegs 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ dwi kū ṭa graṃ zhes gru bzhi nyis brtsegs dang*/ rang bzhin 'od gsal byang sems zla ba'i gdan// rdo rje khu tshur gyis zla gdan 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ tsan+d+ra ā sa na zhes zla gdan te gdan gyi khyad par drug go// 'dod pa'i 'dam gyis ma gos me tog mchog /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis me tog 'thor ba'i tshul dang*/ puṣ+pe zhes me tog dang*/ stong nyid sgra sgrog pi wang ting ting shag /de nyid kyis pi wang sbrel ba dang*/ ting ting shag rdung ba'i tshul dang*| wī ni zhes ting shag sogs dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa'i zag med phung po'i dri// g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis dri'i phye ma 'gyed pa'i tshul dang*/ gan+dhe zhes dri dang*/ nyon mongs bkres sel chos kyi zhal zas mchog |rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis lha bshos 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ nai wi d+ye zhes zhal zas dang*/ ngo tsha khrel yod ldan pa lha yi gos// thal mo brgyangs nas na bza' 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ was+t+ra zhes gos te mchod pa'i khyad par lnga'o| |de nas rgyal srid sna bdun gyi mchod pa ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog

|lag pa gnyis mkhrig ma gnyis bsnol te rgyab sbyar la sor mo rnams gcig la gcig 'khyud de mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bzung la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra rat+na badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'khor lo dang*/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren cing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo gnyis tshigs bcag ste mthe bong gnyis rtse spras pa/ tsakra'i gnas su/ ma ṇi zhes nor bu dang*/ sngags ni thog mtha' 'og ma kun la sbyar ro// btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyud bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /rdo rje thal mo las mdzub mo'i rtse mo bkug nas gung mo mnyam pa'i tshigs su sbyar/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang mor bshad/ ces pa'i rgya dang*/ s+t+rī zhes btsun mo dang*/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo dang tha ma gnyis gshibs te bsgying ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ pu ru ṣa zhes blon po dang*/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg pa rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog |lag g.yon pa'i mthil du g.yas pa'i gru mo bzhag ste bsgrengs la/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur 'og tu glang po'i rnam par byas pas gru mo glang po'i sna ltar byas la/ hasti zhes glang po dang*/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog /khu tshur bcing ba'i gung mo dang srin lag gnyis brkyang*/ mthe bong gnyis rna ba ltar byas la/ tu raṃ ga a shwa zhes rta mchog dang*/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// snyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog */

g.yon go cha 'dzin pa dang g.yas mchog sbyin byas la/ khaḍ+ga zhes dmag dpon te rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul lo// de nas 'dod yon lnga ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos mchod gnas rnams la 'di 'bul gyis// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog bstsal du gsol// de bzhin du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐| zhes gzugs dang*/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan ci mchis pa// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shapad kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes sgra snyan dang*/ phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes dri mchog dang*/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes zhal zas dang*/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta spar+she kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes reg bya ste 'dod yon lnga 'bul lo// de nas dril stabs dang bcas pas/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das// ting nge 'dzin ldan phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal bcom ldan kun rig la// me long ye shes rang bzhin las// sems can ma lus thams cad kyi// ngan song thams cad sbyong mdzad pa// phyag 'tshal sbyong ba'i rgyal po la// mnyam nyid ye shes yon tan bdag /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen ltar// sems can bsam pa skong mdzad pa// rgyal mchog rin chen khyod phyag 'tshal// so sor kun rtog gsung gi bdag

/gsung rab pad+mo'i kha rgyas pa// khams gsum dbugs dbyung mdzad pa po// shākya ri dbang khyod phyag 'tshal| |nan tan ye shes phrin las bdag /sna tshogs sems can sdug bsngal kun/ /ma lus par ni zhi mdzad pa// me tog cher rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal// stong pa nyid kyi rdo rje la| |rin chen rigs rnams kun gyi yum// rdo rje sems mchog rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal rdo rje spyan ma la// mtshan ma med pa'i rdo rje la// rin chen rigs rnams kun gyi yum// rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dbang nyid la// smon pa med pa'i rdo rje la// pad+ma'i rigs rnams skyong mdzad pa// rdo rje rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che| |rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun// rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*// phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la// rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gshegs// don yod rgyal po rdo rje mchog /phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gugs khyod la// rdo rje chags pa bde chen po// rdo rje mda' ni dbang byed pa// bdud kyi 'dod pa rdo rje che// phyag 'tshal rdo rje gzhu rje 'od khyod la// sems can don rab rdo rje dpal// rdo rje rgyal mtshan rab dga' byed// rdo rje chen po rin chen dpal// phyag 'tshal rdo rje dpa' khyod la// rdo rje bzhad mo bzhad pa che// rdo rje 'dzum pa ngo mtshar che// dga' zhing rab dga' rdo rje ston// phyag 'tshal rdo rje dga' ba la// rdo rje chos rab de nyid don// rdo rje pad+mo rab dga' byed// 'jig rten dbang rab rdo rje'i spyan// phyag 'tshal rdo rje spyan khyod la// rdo rje rna ba theg pa che// rdo rje ral gri mtshon chen po// 'jam dpal rdo rje rab tu zab// phyag 'tshal rdo rje rno khyod la| |rdo rje rgyu dang snying po che// rdo rje 'khor lo'i tshul chen po// rab bskor rdo rje las byung ba// phyag 'tshal rdo rje snying po la// rdo rje gsung ba rang rig mchog

/rdo rje zlos pa rab sgrub sbyin| |mi gsung rdo rje mchog sgrub pa// phyag 'tshal rdo rje gsung khyod la// rdo rje las rab rdo rje dka'// las kyi rdo rje kun rab 'gro// rdo rje nges pa rgya che ba//
