dag yon tan rdo rje ste// yid bzhin rdo rje re ba skong*// rdo rje thugs kyi tshul 'dzin ma// phyag 'tshal rdo rje phreng ba la// rnam dag rdo rje gsung mchog ma// rdo rje pi wang 'dzin pa'i tshul// rdo rje gsung mchog sgrog pa'i don// phyag 'tshal rdo rje dbyangs mkhan la// rnam dag rdo rje las rab ster// las kyi rdo rje 'gro don mdzad// bdud 'dul rdo rje'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal rdo rje gar mkhan la// sprin bzhin rdo rje bdug pa ma// tshim byed rdo rje dang ldan pa'i// rdo rje phreng ba'i tshul 'dzin ma// phyag 'tshal rdo rje bdug pa la// rdo rje mdzes pa'i gzugs mdzes shing*// rdo rje me tog 'thor ba'i tshul// byang chub yan lag me tog ste// phyag 'tshal rdo rje me tog la// 'od gsal rdo rje 'bar ba'i me// rdo rje spyan gyis ma rig sel// rdo rje gsal byed phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje snang byed la// rdo rje tsan+dan bdud rtsi'i chu// rdo rje dri yis rnam rtog 'joms// rdo rje dag byed phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje dri mchog la// rnam dag bskul byed rdo rje'i don// rdo rje sdud mdzad rdo rje'i don// rdo rje 'gugs byed phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje lcags kyu la// mi gtong rdo rje chos kyi don// rdo rje 'dren pa mi 'gyur don// 'ching mdzad rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje zhags pa la// rdo rje mi 'gyur brtan pa'i bdag

/rdo rje mgyogs byed glog bzhin myur| |sgrog mdzad rdo rje phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje lcags sgrog la// rdo rje dbab pa brtan pa'i bdag /skyong mdzad rdo rje kun gyi las// rdo rje dbab pa'i phyag rgya 'dzin// phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'bebs pa la/ /sgo yi khyams na bzhugs pa yi/ /byams pa la sogs bcu drug ni/ /rab dga' la sogs gnas mdzad pa'i// byang sems rnams la phyag 'tshal lo| |ston pa'i rtags 'chang nyan thos mchog /lhung bzed 'khar gsil po ti phyag /sbyangs stobs yon tan kun ldan pa// nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rten 'brel don la rten gnas pa'i// 'phags pa rang rgyal bcu gnyis ni// 'byung dang ldog la rab zhugs pa'i// rang rgyal gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo srin po'i cha lugs can// sbrul dang mi sdug mgos brgyan cing*// stag lpags kyis ni rnam dkris pa'i// 'jig rten gsum snang sogs phyag 'tshal// phyi yi khor yug la gnas pa'i// 'jigs byed lha klu gza' skar bcas// phyogs skyong rgyal chen phyag 'tshal zhing*// 'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/ skabs 'dir rtsa rig gi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya'o// // ༈ /sgru+ub grogs la dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug la phyi rol tu phyin te/ gtor ma cha gsum nyer spyod dang bcas pa bshams la bsangs/ gzi byin bskyed/ sbyangs/ sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs/ spyan drang ba ni/ pus mo g.yas btsugs g.yon gyen du bslang*/ lag pa g.yas spos thogs g.yon dril bu gsil zhing*/ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhugs// da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang*// shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ */gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs su gsol// phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan// thugs rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyil po che// lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu// rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gdon gyi bdag

/de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston pa// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal// bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi/ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ ru dra ye/ oṃ sha ta sa ha sra ak+ṣa ye/ oṃ āg+na ye/ oṃ ya mā ye/ oṃ naiṛ t+yaye/ oṃ bā ru ṇa ye/ oṃ bā ya we/ oṃ ku be rā ya/ oṃ ī shwa rā ya/ oṃ ūr+dhaṃ brah+ma ṇa ye/ sūr+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ oṃ a dh+wa pṛ thi wī bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ nā ge bh+yaḥ sa pa ri wā ra pra wa ra sat+kā raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes gdan 'bul/ oṃ in+d+rā ya/ āg+na ye/ ya mā ye/ naiṛ t+ya ye/ bā ru ṇa ye/ bā ya we/ ku be rā ya/ ī shwa rā ya/ ūr+dhaṃ brah+ma/ sūr+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ a dh+wa pṛ thi wī bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ nā ge bh+yaḥ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha// lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me ste sreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha// ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha// srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha// klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha// rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag

/nub byang gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to 'dzin// nor srung rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ */dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha// 'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*// nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po// gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// 'og gi klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*| |dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// rdor thal kha phye bas/ in+d+rā ya/ sogs kyi mthar/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ/ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol// me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*// dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*// steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*/ /lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu/ /ri yi lha dang gnod sbyin tshogs bcas la// swaḥswaḥso sor gtor ma phul ba rnams// rab tu dgyes pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas su| |rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang*// rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bcas// nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs cig tu// phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas// bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na// 'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes pa nas/

yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar brjod/ in+d+rā ya/ sogs kyi mthar/ sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha btags la gshegs/ 'byung gtor ni/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul// nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po// dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*// gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa rnams// bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni// thal mo sbyar nas khyod la gsol 'debs kyi// gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir spyon cig /oṃ e h+ye hi lo ka ka ra/ de wa/ nā ga /yak+ṣa/ gan+dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga /ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya/ sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ de wa/ nas/ sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas phul/ oṃ de wa/ nas/ sa pa ri wā ra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ/ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*// dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*// shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*// ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*// rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*// chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang*// g.ya' chu bsil ma can la gang gnas dang*// grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang*// khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang*// gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang*// dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang*// rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang*// lam 'phrang sum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*// gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung*// dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*// seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas dag dang*// 'brog chen 'jigs su rung ba gang gnas dang*// gang dag gling mchog dag na gang gnas dang*// lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams// rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas kyang*// me tog phreng ba dri dang byug par bcas// bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na// 'di dag btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// ces phul/

de wa/ sogs kyi mthar/ sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha btags pas gshegs su gsol/ bgegs gtor ni/ rang nyid 'jig rten gsum rgyal du bskyed/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*// bden pa chen po'i mthus bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir mchis par gyur cig /ṭa ki hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ sarba bigh+nāṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gong gi sngags gsum po'i rjes su/ sarba bigh+nāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ/ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ gsum gyis gtor ma byin la/ gang zhig mtshan mor rgyu ba yi// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*// srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa// de dang de la gtor ma 'di// bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas// 'bras chan 'bras bu mang po yi// mchod pa 'di yis mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid// de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis// rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*// dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod// 'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste// dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de// mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med// 'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem// rang gi lus la dpe long la// gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung du gang dag gis// lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i// nad de nye par phyung nas su// gdon de rang gi gnas su dengs// de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyi// mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yi// dam tshig la ni gnas nas su// bdag gi bsam pa skong bar mdzod// rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing*// 'dir ni bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nad de rab tu sol mdzod la// gdon rnams rang gi gnas su song*// oṃ sarba bigh+nāṃ gats+tshas gshegs/

de nas kha sna mig rna lag lte ba'o// zhes pa rnams su nye reg byas nas/ slob dpon gyis rjes mnan te nang du 'ongs la/ rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad du gsal ba'i me tog gi phreng ba bzung ste/ rdo rje shugs kyis dkyil 'khor du zhugs par bsam la/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ rdo rje gsor dril bu gsil zhing dkyil 'khor la skor ba lan gsum byas nas dkyil 'khor la bltas te me tog gtso bo la dbul/ de nas sngags kyi sgo 'byed pa'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ badz+roṅghā ṭa sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas sgo phye ste/ de nas/ oṃ sa ma ya pra we sha yā mi/ zhes sngar phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba gar byed cing blangs la rang gi mgo la bcings te/ oṃ pra ṇām mi sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes dkyil 'khor la phyag byas te/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi bka' drin stsol cig /ces gsol ba gdab par bya'o// de nas/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pas dbang gi bya ba rnams mdzad par gyur par bsam zhing dngos su rang gis phyag byas la/ khrus bya/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ thal mo sbyar te/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal// zhes gsum gyi gsol ba gdab/ oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dha wa ra mā na ye hūm̐/ zhes las thams cad la bzlas pas dar ser pos gdong g.yogs shing*/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes me tog gi phreng ba gtad la/ dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang*// rjes su yi rang yang na bgyid stsal gang*// de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni// spyan sngar da lta ma lus so sor bshags// bde gshegs sras kyi tshogs gnyis zab pa dang*// rgya chen 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don// sgrub par byed dang de las gzhan la yang*// rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// thugs rjes khyab pa'i thugs dang ldan gyur cing*// blo gros sdig bral gti mug tshogs kun bcom// ma lus rigs kyi pad+ma'i nang bzhugs pa// bde bar gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi// blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba ste// dman pa'i 'jigs pa rnams kyi rgyal byed tshal// srid pa'i 'byor ba zil gyis gnon pa'i mchog

/gsung mchog chos la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// 'dod chags la sogs sbrul gyi dug bcom zhing*// blo gros rnam dag thugs rje che ldan pa// brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs mchi zhing*// srid dang bral ba rnams la'ang bdag phyag 'tshal// rgyu yi rjes la bdag po'i yul bdag nyid// 'bras bu'i stobs kyis dgra las rgyal gyur pa'i// snying rje'i rtsa ba zug cing yang dag rtogs// mnyam med byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi| |sems can rnams ni yongs su smin pa'am// yang na yongs su bskyab par bya phyir ram// rang gi sems ni dag par bya ba'i phyir// de dag thams cad rtswa sogs bzhin du gtang*| |de bzhin tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab bla na med pa ni// bdag dang gzhan la phan par bya ba'i phyir// skad cig re re bzhin yang bsgom par bgyi// bde bar gshegs pa sngags la mkhas pa yi// chos rgyal rtag tu lhun gyis grub pa ni// 'gro ba 'di yis thob par bya ba'i phyir// khyad 'phags gnas la bdag ni gnas par bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung ba ni sngar bzhin lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u duṃ wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// bla med byed par nus pa min// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag thams cad zad 'gyur na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na| |sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa| |bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du// da lta rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// rang byung skal pa chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes zab mo'i chos bshad la/

thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa ni/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes dang*/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i sems bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i dbus su don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i rnam par gyur par mos la/ rdo rje snying gar bzung ste/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ zhes sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes shar sgo nas gzhug /a sa me/ tri sa me/ ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes pas/ lha rnams dang skal pa mnyam par byas so// zhes brjod/ dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po 'di ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag /rdo rje snying gar bzung la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la// 'di smras na ni spyi bo 'gem// zhes nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag /slar yang rdo rje mgo bor bzhag ste/ deng nas khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par byas na ya nga ba ma spang bar tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes slob dpon gyi bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag go// de nas rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du bzhag ste/

oṃ bri ta bri ta sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa| oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ gnas nyer gnyis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ sarba bid badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs la dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsum brjod/ gtso bo la sogs lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes a yig gi rnam par char bab pa lta bu snying gar zla ba dang rdo rje'i dbus su 'jug cing 'od kyis lus thams cad kun tu gang bar gyur par bsam/ oṃ pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes lan bcu sogs brjod pas/ ye shes dbab/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hṛ da ya mi pra we sha dṛ ḍho tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ zhes brtan par bya/ de nas/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni// 'gro la phan phyir gtso chen gyis// sman par dgongs te bzhes su gsol// oṃ pra tīts+tsha sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dkyil 'khor du dor la de nyid/ me tog rin chen la sogs pa// gang la phog pa rigs kyi lha// gtso bo'i rigs te bsgrub na ni// dngos grub 'grub par the tshom med// ces brjod/ mig dbye ba ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyis// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra hā s+ya uṅghā ṭa ya hūm̐/ zhes gdong g.yogs dkrol/ oṃ badz+ra pa sh+ya hoḥ dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong bar gyur par mos la/ dam chu sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi 'di yis 'grub// ci ste dam tshig 'das na ni/ */ de ma thag tu bkas nas gshegs/

/rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas ni// bdun rgyud rigs ni brlag par byed// de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang*// sdom pa dang ni bla ma'i bka'// shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya// khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya// ma byin par yang blang mi bya// rdzun dang 'dod log spyod pa rnams// dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba min// chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing*// sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya// sems can gnod pa'i sbyor ba ni// nam yang bya ba ma yin no| |dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spong*// dus kun tu ni byang chub sems// snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang*// lha dang bla ma de bzhin no// sdig pa la sogs gang yin dang*// bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya// lha la phul ba'i rnying pa dang*// de yi grib ma'ang 'gom mi bya// phyag rgya'i gzugs la'ang de bzhin no// sngags dang lha la smad mi bya// gdon gyi las sogs bya ba min// mu stegs can la smad mi bya// mdor na yid gnyis the tshom som nyi mi bya ste// bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no// zhes dam tshig bsgrag go// de rnams ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir| |nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor dbang stegs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan par gyur par dmigs te/ rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bzung ste bum chu sbyin zhing*/ rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// las dang nyon mongs dri ma kun dag nas// byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog

/oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ oṃ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ oṃ rat+na ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ oṃ karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes dbang bum lnga'am med na rnam rgyal gyis spyi gtsug dang dpral ba/ rna ltag g.yas g.yon ltag pa rnams su dbang bskur| de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan cod pan 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te// rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ badz+ra dang hūm̐ gi gnas su/ bud+dha sogs gong bzhin sbyar bas mgo bo'i gnas lngar rigs lnga'i dam rgya cod pan gyis dbang bskur/ sna tshogs rin chen nor bu'i phreng ba 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// bsam pa myang 'das sbyor ba khams gsum gnas// mdzes pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ rat+na mā lā a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ/ zhes pas rgyal mchog rin chen gyi dam rgyas con pan gyi yan lag phreng bas dbang bskur/ kha dog lnga ldan dar gyi cod pan 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// shes bya kun la thogs pa med pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par shog /oṃ badz+ra pa ṭa a wa laṃ ba a bhi ṣiñca trāṃ/ zhes snying ga /mgrin pa/ ltag pa/ nu bar/ rgyab/ dpral ba rnams mdud de mthar mnyam pa'i thal mo byas la dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya lag tu gtad nas ni// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te// ye shes lnga ni myur du thob par shog /oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ de bzhin du/ bud+dha dang oṃ gyi gnas su/ badz+ra dang hūm̐ sogs sbyar la/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan rnams de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dang bcas pa lag tu byin la dam tshig gi dbang bskur/

kun rdzob mtshan nyid mtshon pa ming gi dbang*// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// ma 'ongs sangs rgyas 'jig rten zhing khams su// de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gyi ming thob shog /oṃ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ badz+ra dang hūm̐ gi gnas su/ bud+dha dang oṃ sbyar zhing*/ snying ga /mgo bo/ dpral ba/ spyi gtsug rnams su rdo rje dril bu rgya gram du bzung la dkrol te ming gi dbang bskur/ rdo rje rgya gram lag tu gtad nas ni/ skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'gro don mthar phyin te// las kyi rigs kyi dngos grub thob par shog /oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes pas sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu gtad la phrin las kyi brtul zhugs sbyin no// gnyis pa ni/ yon tan rab rdzogs gser gyi 'khor lo 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// rnam par snang 'dzad sku mchog rab thob ste// chos kyi 'khor lo myur du bskor bar shog /oṃ badz+ra tsakra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ bh+rūṃ/ zhes pas 'khor lo rkang pa gnyis kyi bar reg nas byin la chos 'chad pa spyi'i slob dpon du dbang bskur/ rigs lnga'i bdag po yi ni rang bzhin gyis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas/ */rdo rje sems dpa' rigs rnams kun gyi bdag */ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag por shog /oṃ badz+ra tsakra a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ badz+ra dang hūm̐ gi gnas su/ bud+dha dang oṃ sogs sbyar zhing rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gnas lngar btugs la chos 'chad pa so so'i slob dpon du dbang bskur/ yum lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag nas ni// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// gsang rgyud mtha' dag shes shing rtogs nas su// 'chad cing ston pa'i dbang dang ldan par shog /oṃ badz+ra dha ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/

de bzhin du/ badz+ra dang hūm̐ gi gnas su/ bud+dha dang oṃ sogs sbyar zhing yum lnga dang*/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya gnas lngar bcings nas ni// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// ye shes lnga yi yon tan rab rdzogs te// byang sems gsang ba'i dbang dang ldan par shog /oṃ bud+dha guh+ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ de bzhin du/ bud+dha dang oṃ gyi gnas su/ badz+ra dang hūm̐ sogs sbyar la rigs lnga'i dam rgya snying ga sogs gnas lngar gtugs te gsang ba'i dbang bskur/ de nas/ de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyi// phyag rgya rdo rje nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin// khyod kyis de ltar bya dgos so// oṃ pradz+nyā u pā ya sa ma ya yo ga a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ āḥ zhes pas rdo rje dril bu lag tu byin la thabs shes mnyam sbyor gyi dbang bskur/ gnyis pa ni/ gnas skabs su 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid dang*/ mthar thug chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur bar bya ba'i phyir/ rin chen sna bdun gyi gzugs sam/ phyag rgya lag tu reg la/ lha rdzas las byas lte ba shin tu zlum// rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang*// sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ// rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas baiḍūr+ya// kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing*// dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin// nor bu rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// ma ṇi= sngags tshig gzhan gong ltar 'gre'o/ gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang ma// pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan// yid 'ong 'dod rgu reg bya dang ldan pa'i// btsun mo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro| |s+t+rī= /gang yang rgyal bas mu tig mdangs ldan pa// gser sogs mang po thub la phul ba ltar// bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan te// blon po rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// pu ru ṣa=

/yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni// rab gnas gangs can ri 'dra glang po che// rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro bas// glang po rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// hasti= /tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa// sa rnams bskor zhing slar yang ldog byed pa// rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong ba// rta mchog rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// tu raṃ ga a shwa= /'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong 'gyur ba'i// ma lus bdud dpung 'joms par byed pa yi// dpa' brtan 'byor ba'i dpung dang bcas pa yi// dmag dpon rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ khaḍ+ga rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ// zhes pas rin chen bdun gyis dbang bskur/ dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems| |bla ma dam pa rnams mi spang*// srog chags rnams ni gsad mi bya// ma byin par yang mi blang zhing*// rdzun du smra bar bya ba min// pha rol bud med spyad mi bya// bla ma smad par mi bya ste// de yi grib mar mi 'gom zhing*// slob dpon ma yin mi gzung la// rdo rje slob dpon mtshan mi brjod// sngags dang phyag rgya mi smad de// lha rnams la yang smos ci dgos// ci ste glan pas smad na ni// nad kyis nges par 'chi bar 'gyur// rnying dang lha yi grib ma dang*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa rnams// phyag rgya yi ge mtshan ma rnams// gom pas 'gom par mi bya'o// de bas dkon mchog gsum sogs dang*// sangs rgyas bstan la gnod byed dang*// bla ma smod la brtson pa rnams// mkhas pas bsgrims te gsad par bya// chos mi ldan dang sdig spyod dang*// rtag tu sems can gnod brtson dang*// dam tshig sdang rnams snying brtse bas// sngags mkhan gyis ni sngags kyis gsad// 'jungs pa rnams kyi nor blangs la// sems can phongs la byin par bya// bla ma la ni mchod pa dang*// de ltar dam tshig bsgrub pa dang*// dkyil 'khor phyir dang dam tshig can// phan phyir rgyal ba'i sras rnams la| |mchod phyir mi yi bdag po'am// phyug po rnams kyi nor 'phrog bsrung ba dang*// sngags mkhan gyis ni bsgrub pa'i phyir// gzhan gyi bud med bsten par bya| |rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug cing*// thams cad za zhing kun byas kyang*// 'grub 'gyur nyes par mi 'gyur oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ādz+nyā te dā s+ya mi gṛh+ṇa badz+ra su sid+dhi ye hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ zhes pas bka'i dbang bskur/ oṃ sarba karma ṇi ku ru bud+dhā nāṃ hūm̐/ zhes pas rdo rje lag tu byin la las kyi dbang bskur/ dam tshig dang*/ bka' dang*/ las kyi dbang 'di gsum ni cho ga bsdus pa'i dbang du ma byas kyang mi 'gal lo// de nas phan yon brjod pa ni/ tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang*// 'jig rten phyi ma'i bde mchog dang*// sangs rgyas nyid kyang 'thob 'gyur na// lha yi bde ba smos ci dgos// sangs rgyas kun dang bla ma mnyam// rdo rje slob dpon brnyas na ni// rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob 'gyur bas// slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya// rdo rje spun dang sring mo dang*// rdo rje ma rnams nyid la ni// rnal 'byor can gyis brnyas mi bya// rtag tu 'khon dang gcugs mi bya// dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed la// bzod pa bsgom par mi bya ste// bla ma smod brtson ma rungs dang*// dam tshig las ni 'gal ba dang*// de sogs byed pa tshar bcad na// 'grub 'gyur zhes ni kun rig gsungs// sems can kun la snying brtser chags/ */bsgrubs nas myur du 'grub par 'gyur// zhes phan yon bstan pa'i sgo nas dam tshig la gnas par gdam mo// gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// ces dam tshig bsrung bar khas blang*/ lus longs spyod thams cad bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la phul te drug cha gcig dngos grub kyi slad du zhu snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes brjod gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ de dag ni bdag nyid 'jug pa'i rim pa'o// slob ma la dbang bskur dgos na/ bdag 'jug ltar las sta gon dang dbang gi ngag sbyor dkyil 'khor gyi las rim sogs logs su bshad pa ltar bya'o/// /

༈ /de nas gshin po rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ lho sgo'i cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su stegs bu khru gang gru bzhi ba'i steng du/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa bris pa'i dbus su yi ge legs par btags pa'i ro'am/ rus bu'am/ ming byang sogs bzhag la/ las bum gyi chu dang las thams cad pas bsangs/ oṃ shū n+ya tās sbyangs/ rten snang ba mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las/ tshe 'das kyi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las tshe las 'das pa tha mal pa'i cha byad can phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched thams cad gsal zhing yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa a thung gi gzugs can bkug ste rten gyi spyi gtsug nas brgyud snying gar thim par gyur/ ces dmigs la rdo rje bsdams pa nang du bcings/ mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs pa cung zad bkug mthe'u chung gnyis khab ltar brkyang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ dzaḥ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa rnams dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rigs sngags rnams kyi lha'i khyad par rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i rnam par shes pa srid pa bar ma do khams gsum/ 'gro ba rigs drug /skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i 'jig rten gang du gnas kyang skad cig nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig /ces lan gsum sogs brjod/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba pā paṃ ā na ya hūm̐/

zhes tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib rnams kyang bkug par bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi nang du mdzub mo lcags sgrog ltar bcings la legs par gyen du 'phang ba ltung ba slong ba'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ sarba a pā ya ā kar+ṣa ṇi bi sho dha na badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ngan 'gro thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol tu bkug par bsam| de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das bdag cag sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba 'di las bskyab tu gsol/ bdag cag sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang khyod la yang skyabs su mchi'o| zhes skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo sgreng*/ mthe bong gnyis dang mthe'u chung bsrangs te mnye zhing dril pa sdig pa gzhom pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba a pā ya/ bhan+dha ni pra mok+ṣa ṇa/ sarba a pā ya ga te bh+yaḥ sarba trā sa naṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya traṭa kyis sdig pa thams cad bcom zhing zhi bar bsam/ oṃ sarba bid sarba pā paṃ a pā ya bi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā| badz+ra bhan+dha traṭa ces brjod cing sngar ltar snying gar rdo rje bsdams pa sgra dang bcas pas lan gsum dral bas tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs par bsam/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ zhes sogs kyis sngar 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi skabs ltar gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcangs nas/ mthe bong dang gung mo dang mthe'u chung gyen du bsgrengs te kha sbyar nas/ mdzub mo dang ming med sems dpa'i skyil krung du byas pa rdo rje'i phyag rgya/ snying ga lkog ma kha phyogs su// dpral ba mdzod spu rnam pa gnyis// mgo bo gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis// sna dang rked pa pus mo bol// long bu sna yi rtse mo dang*// mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba'i gnas// zhes pa'i gnas nyer gnyis su gtug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/

de nas bgegs sbyang ba ni/ gtor ma gsum bshams la byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ sarba bigh+nāṃ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs gsum gyis rten la bskor zhing bgegs la bsngo zhing zhi bas sbyangs/ ting lo'i mar me dang chang bu sbrags nas rten la phyir bskor zhing*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha ni hūm̐/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa zhes sogs brjod cing bskor ba ni zhi drag phyed mas sbyangs ba'o/ de nas khro bo spyan drangs nas mchod bstod sngar ltar byas la/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ zhes pa nas/ bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ tshe las 'das pa zhes bgyi ba la gson gyi dus su tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing tshe phrogs nas gang du gnas pa'i lus srog dang*/ mtho ris dang*/ thar pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad dang*/ tshe las 'das pa'i cha byad bzung nas de'i nye 'brel dang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams la bslu zhing gnod par byed pa'i gnod sbyin dang*/ sha za dang*/ 'byung po la sogs pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnod pa dang 'tshe ba'i bsam pa ngan pa thams cad spong la/ phan pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas rang rang so so'i gnas su song zhig /gal te mi 'gro na ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba rnams kyis sreg cing rnam par 'joms par gdon mi za'o// zhes brjod cing*/ su+uṃ bha ni'i sngags drag tu bzla/ gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya ba ni drag po'i sbyong ba'o// de nas bsangs shing sbyangs la/ raṃ las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing zhal gdangs par skad cig gis bskyed la/ tshe 'das kyi rkang mthil gnyis su rlung gi dkyil 'khor lte bar ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis snying ga'i paṃ ded nas kha sgo nas thon/

sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til la thim par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mkha' 'gro'i zhal du phul nas gsol bar bsam pa ni sbyin sreg gi sbyang ba'o// de nas bye ma'am yungs kar la kaṃ ka ni dang*/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang*/ gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs dang*/ rtsa rig dang lha rnams kyi sngags spel tshig bcas pa bzlas nas/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha na badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇā ni bhasmiṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bruṃ bi nā sha ya ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ bi sho dha ya ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la da ka da ka ha na ha na ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ ha ra ha ra sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni bi s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bri ta bri ta sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na rak+ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tiraya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla zhing rten la brab bo// de nas dkyil 'khor dang ras bris sogs kyi sku gzugs me long du shar ba la khrus gsol zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes ras dkar gyis dbyi zhing*/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal te// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig

/oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes khrus ras la dri'i thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes dbyi/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med| |byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal te// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes khrus ras la dri'i thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes dbyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mo bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta= rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus rab bsal te// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ zhes khrus ras la dri'i thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes dbyi/ zhes bkrus pa'i chu bum par blugs la/ ro yin na dngos su dang*/ ming byang yin na nub gong ma rnams la me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba dang tha ma dngos su bkru zhing*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te zhes rtsa rig brjod pa'i rjes su/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song zhing tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du nyon mongs pa ser sna'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te/

myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /de bzhin du sbyin pa zhes pa'i gnas su/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan| shes rab ces dang*/ ser sna zhes pa'i gnas su/ tshul 'chal/ khong khro/ le lo/ rnam g.yeng*/ shes 'chal zhes pa rnams bcug ste sngar bzhin bkrus la/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te zhes dang*/ dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas// dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te zhes dang*/ dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te zhes tshigs bcad re dang*/ rtsa rig spel ba'i mthar/ 'jig rten 'di nas zhes pa nas/ khyad par du pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad byang zhing dag nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs te/ myur du zhes sogs brjod/ nyon mongs pa dang de'i dbang gis byung ba'i dug bsal ba'i phyir/ */'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te zhes dang*/ 'jig rten 'di nas zhes pa nas/ khyad par du nyon mongs pa dang*/ de'i dbang gis byung ba'i dug thams cad byang zhing dag nas myur du zhes sogs brjod/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas zhes pa'i gnas su/ bcom ldan dam chos zhes dang*/ dam chos gzi yis zhes dang*/ na mo bha ga wa te zhes dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun zhes dang*/ dge 'dun gzi yis zhes dang*/ na mo bha ga wa te zhes spel tshig dang bcas pa sbyar ro// sa ni dug gi ma yin te// sa ni dug gi pha yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// tshe 'das dug ni dug med shog

khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur// yid 'phrog gang dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig

/sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis// khyed kyi don 'dod gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde gyur cig /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyin ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// khyed cag kun la bde legs gyur// khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces dril bu gsil zhing me tog dor la/ che ge mo zhes bya ba'i bdud dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /de nas bu la sogs pas ming byang bzung nas phyag byed pa'am med kyang rung ste/ tshe 'das de nyid bsam pa thag pas dkon mchog gsum dang nye ba'i sras brgyad la skyabs su 'gro zhing phyag byed par bsam la/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel ba// de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs su mchi// tshe 'das 'jigs pas rnam skrag nas// kun tu bzang la tshe 'das 'bul// 'jam dpal dbyangs la bdag nyid kyis// tshe 'das lus 'di dbul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ro'i 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan 'di la bskyab tu gsol| |'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje che mgon thams cad la// skyabs 'tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi| |pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bcur dbyer mdzad pa'i// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyod kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas| |khyod la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// zhes brjod par bsam/

de rnams ni phyir zlog gis sbyang ba'o// skabs 'dir bdag 'jug ltar na maṇ+ḍal phul la/ dga' chen khyod bdag ces gsol ba gdab pa nas/ bsgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur// zhes dam tshig la gnas par bstan pa'i bar gyis dbang bskur ba'am/ rgyas par na zur du bshad pa ltar bya ba ni/ bod spros pa la dga' bas sngon gyi mkhas pa chen po dag gis mdzad pa yin pas phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur la/ bsdus pa na sngags tsam gyis dbang bskur yang cho ga chad pa'i skyon cung zad kyang mi 'byung zhes/ kun mkhyen bu dang 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs kyi gzhung las 'byung ba'o// de nas/ gdan pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur par mos te/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// zhes sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ 'dod yon rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes dang*/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs dang*// 'jig rten pha rol song ba'i tshe 'das la// de ring las dang 'brel ba'i nye du yis| |nam zhag gtan gyi zas skom 'di bsngos bas// tshe 'das mi zad gter la spyod par shog /tshe 'das 'dod yon lnga la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra satwa rū pa shapad sogs brjod/ ces pa'i tshigs bcad kyis tshe 'das lhar bskyed pas mchod/ de nas/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba'i// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par dag pa'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun byang nas// 'phags pa'i lam der bgrod par shog

/oṃ rat+ne rat+ne ma hā rat+ne rat+na saṃ bha we/ rat+na ki rat+ne/ rat+na mā la bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lam bstan la/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i// srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba// bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma saṃ bha we ma hā su kha wa tī gats+tshan+tu swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor te lam sbyangs pas/ tshe las 'das pa'i rnam par shes pa dang*/ lha ye shes pa dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i spyi gtsug nas thon te bde ba can tu gshegs/ der pad+ma las brdzus te skyes nas de na gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ des sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong*/ mchod nas gdams pa dang rjes su gnang ba thob/ lha rnams kyis brtags pas bdag gi mthur shes pas bdag nyid la gong ltar mchod nas/ sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med// chos dang 'dra ba'i dge ba med// dge 'dun 'dra ba'i zhing med de// sngags dang 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med// ces ched du brjod par bsam/ des kyang der skye ba'i rgyu brtags pas bdag gis cho ga bgyis pa'i mthur shes te skad cig gis 'ongs nas// e ma shākya mgon po yi// sangs rgyas mdzad pa ya mtshan che// gang phyir ngan song lhung ba yi// sems can glog bzhin myur du sgrol// de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyang bsam mi khyab// sngags kyi yon tan rnams kyang bsam mi khyab// byang chub bstan pa rnams kyang bsam mi khyab// tshangs spyod tshul khrims dri med e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni// sngags kyi mdzad pa ya mtshan che// gang phyir ngan song lhung ba yi// sems can lha gnas myur du skyes// zhes ched du brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/

slar yang bde ba can du gshegs par gyur// oṃ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra gats+tshan+tu swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas lha dang rnam shes gshegs pa'i lhag ma ro'am/ byang bu sdig sgrib lhan cig tu raṃ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi mes bsreg par bsam la/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu// gson cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu| |phung po lnga yi bud shing la// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro// 'byung ba bzhi yi bud shing la// lha mo bzhi yi me sbar ro// nyon mongs lnga yi bud shing la// ye shes lnga yi me sbar ro| |dbang po drug gi bud shing la// byang chub sems kyi me sbar ro// yul snang drug gi bud shing la// lha mo drug gi me sbar ro// lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la// rgyal ba'i sku gsum me sbar ro// sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du// 'gro ba'i don du 'grub par shog /ces rtsa rig brjod cing bsreg go// kha cig lam bstan sbyang gi gong du bsregs te/ gzod lam bstan sbyang byed pa'ang snang ngo*// de nas rjes kyi cho ga ni/ sngar ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ zhing khams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon rgya mtsho dpag med kyis// sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dpag med mchod// sems can rgya mtsho'i don kun mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ya ye hūm̐/ zhes chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams kyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /ces pa nas/ me tog cher rgyas khyod phyag 'tshal// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ grwa yi phyogs ni kun tu yang*// rigs kyi yum bzhi'i skur ston pa// lha mo spyan dang mā ma kī// dkar mo sgrol ma khyod phyag 'tshal// rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad na// bzhugs pa rdo rje sems dpa' sogs// rdzu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams// rgyud bzhin bdag gis bstod par bgyi// sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin glu// gar sogs lha mo bzhi po dang*// spos dang me tog mar me ma// dri yi lha mo khyod phyag 'tshal// sgo bzhi'i dbus na bzhugs pa yi// dad sogs ngo bo rnam dag pa'i// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// sgo ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo// sgo yi khyams na bzhugs pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug dang*// nyan thos chen po bcu drug dang*// rang rgyal chen po bcu gnyis dang*// khro bo mngag pa pho nya bran// mgron thabs lha la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi yi khor yug la gnas pa'i// 'jigs byed lha klu gza' skar bcas// phyogs skyong rgyal chen phyag 'tshal zhing*// 'jig rten pa kun bstod par bgyi// bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod/

dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs brjod/ sems ma rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya bcings te/ badz+ra satwa dang yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur phyir// de ni mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces nongs pa bzod par gsol/ de nas lha rang rang gi dam rgyas/ sarba bid sogs rang rang gi snying po lan gsum gsum bzla zhing*/ badz+ra muḥ zhes so so'i mjug tu se gol gtogs cing dam rgya bkrol la/ ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la bsdu/ ras bris yin na mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor brtan bzhugs bya/ bdag dang bum bskyed kyi lha tshogs gshegs/ rdul tshon la mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa'ang gshegs su gsol/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur par bsam/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ zhes sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ byang phyogs kyi sems dpa' bzhi'i sngags rgyas bsrungs la/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa'i 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ */ de yis de ring khyed la zhi byed bkra shis shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// de yis de ring khyed la zhi byed bkra shis shog /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// de yis de ring khyed la zhi byed bkra shis shog /ces sogs rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ro// 'dir smras pa/ rnam mang rnal 'byor rgyud sde mtha' yas kyi// snying po ngan song sbyong ba'i tan+t+ra las// bcud phyung chog bsgrigs sngon byung mkhas rnams kyis// bka' rtsom mdzad rnams legs par bsdus byas nas// don rnams gsal byed ngag gi 'dod 'jo 'di// blo gsal 'jug bde las kyi sgrib pa rnams/

/kun nas sbyong phyir chog bsgrigs 'dir 'bad byas// gzhan gzhung kun la ma brten pa'i// rang bzos bstan bcos 'chad rtsom pa// blun po dad gus skyed nus kyang*// mkhas pa kun gyis rtog dpyod byed// rgyal ba'i gsung dang de mi mthun| |de phyir de 'dra spang byar 'os// 'di bris bsod nams mthu dang bden pa'i byin rlabs thugs rje'i chus// kun nas ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dus me'i tshad gdung rab zhi nas// 'gro kun sa lam yon tan rab rdzogs rnam par snang mdzad go 'phang myur thob cing*// sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas te snying po'i bstan pa'ang yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang rang nyid nyams su blang ba'i phyir dang*/ sprul sku bstan 'dzin phun tshogs kyi bkas bskul bar brten/ 'di nyid kyi chog bsgrigs khungs thub mang rab cig la brten nas/ shākya'i dge slong dharma kīrtis kun dga' lo hor zla bdun pa'i dus tshes dge bar dpal ri bo che stag lung rdo rje gdan gnyis pa'i sa'i cha bde 'dabs steng du sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//

de nas me bsangs sbyangs la/ hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du/ dz+wa la raṃ zhes ye shes kyi me sbar ba'i dbus su| paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis thugs kar hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa/ zhal gdangs par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ ā hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros ye shes pa spyan drangs| dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings kyi mkha' chen mo// rdo rje gsung mchog dkyil 'khor du// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ de nas tshe 'das kyi rkang pa gnyis su rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis/ lte ba'i ye shes kyi me sbar/ snying gar sdig pa'i sa bon paṃ nag po de la lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad 'dus par bsam/ lte ba'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis snying ga'i paṃ ded nas sna sgo nas thon te sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas lag pa'i mthil lam/ snod du til nag po la sdig pa'i gzugs byas par thim par bsams te/ mdzub mo dang mthe bo'i dbus su hūm̐ bsams la/ des bcad nas khro bo'i zhal du phul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā' hā/ zhes bzlas shing til bsregs pas sdig pa dag par bsams la/ mchod bstod byas te gshegs su gsol lo// //
